name: fab
title: Floating Action Button
description: A fixed floating button that reveals mini action buttons in any direction, or morphs into a toolbar.
improvements: Menu button pattern: aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, arrow keys between actions, Escape closes and refocuses.
Hover mode still works with touch, click and keyboard.
Staggered CSS transitions without anime.js, disabled for reduced motion.
position="static" for inline use and a clip-path toolbar morph.
